svg.aria-label: Read old memory; carry new memory forward
svg.text: Read old memory; carry new memory forward
Kimi K3: 3 KDA layers → 1 Gated MLA layer
Vertical: representations. Horizontal: each layer’s own memory.
This MLA uses NoPE; there is no separate positional key
Both interfaces coexist; MLA’s KV still grows with history.
Source: Kimi K3 v1 §2.1 / Fig.2. FFNs omitted; terminal MLA also used.
